title: Exploring Linear Regression Parameters
text:
This Shiny interface allows users to explore the various parameters of a linear regression interactively. It is designed to facilitate understanding of how parameters affect the results of the regression.



Technology Used: Shiny
Objective: To provide an interactive tool for visualizing and understanding the parameters of a linear regression.
